game.name: A Dinosaur's Tale
game.desc: Play as the characters from Spielberg's animated film "The Dinosaurs Are Back." Run and jump through a variety of levels and defeat Professor Screweyes. Each first level is a side-scrolling platformer where you take on the role of human children Cecilia or Louie and move through obstacles to reach the end of the level. These levels take place in various locations in New York, including a TV studio and a circus that wants to keep dinosaurs for an exhibition. Every other stage is a 3D stage where you play as one of the dinosaur characters, for example, skateboarding in the back of a pickup truck as Rex or flying as Elsa over Central Park while collecting balloons. This is one of the first Mega Drive games with 3D gameplay.

game.name: Alien Soldier
game.desc: Alien Soldier is a side-scrolling action game in which the player takes on the role of Epsilon-Eagle, the former leader of the mutant group Scarlet. The mutants are now led by the evil Xi-Tiger who has turned them into terrorists, and one of his goals is to kill Epsilon-Eagle... At the start of the game, the player chooses four of six weapons - each with special advantages or disadvantages against certain enemies. The Epsilon-Eagle mutant also has other special powers, e.g. ex. teleporting across the screen or (with full health) transforming into a powerful phoenix destroying everything in its path. The 25 stages consist of short side-scrolling sequences and some boss fights. In fact, bosses appear throughout most of the game and side-scrolling sequences are mainly used to give the player the opportunity to collect ammo. Bosses have their own patterns and weaknesses.

game.name: Alisia Dragoon
game.desc: When she was a child, Alisia went through the worst period of her life: the murder of her father. To this day, terrible nightmares permeate his nights. The person responsible for this horrendous evil was the evil sorcerer Baidour. On the day of the tragedy Alisia swore: "Baldour will regret having caused so much suffering." However, in order for her to keep her word, she will have to defeat battalions of terrible barbarians, monstrous poisonous centipedes and squadrons of winged gnomes. You will only have your magical powers and one of four friendly creatures that will help protect you. Will she be able to destroy the cocoon where Baldour rests before he wakes up? We believe so, because she is tough, warrior and dangerous: she is Alisia Dragoon!

game.name: Castlevania : The New Generation
game.desc: In the year 1917, evil threatened to rise again in Transylvania. A young woman named Elizabeth Bartley, who was tried as a witch and killed centuries ago, was planning to resurrect the Prince of Darkness, Count Dracula, once again. The last of the Belmont line, John Morris, and his friend Eric Lecarde, must now travel across Europe to the Palace of Versailles in France, where Bartley is planning the resurrection. And on their way, Dracula's strongest followers follow...

game.name: Comix Zone
game.desc: The first interactive comic book in history! More than a comic book. More than a video game. Take part in this adventure alongside Sketch Turner, a cartoonist who became trapped in the world of comics he created. Now, to be able to return to the real world, our hero must fight frame by frame of the magazine, passing through all the obstacles that appear in front of him. This will not be an easy task, as with each page turned, mutant enemies will be drawn to try to annihilate you. Failing... means staying in the Comix Zone forever!!! Instead of traditional scenarios, each fight takes place in a story comic with balloons and everything! There are 24 Mega of lots of action, with the original multi-scrolling perspective.

game.name: DEcapAttack
game.desc: Things seem to be getting crazy on Body Island! Max D. Cap took control of the body-shaped island, chopping it into little pieces. But Dr. Frank N. Stein has already announced that this will not stay like that! It had long been known that he created strange beings for his experiments. And Chuck D. Head, the two-headed monster, was the one he destined to fight Max D. Cap's army, collect coins, find and use the island's magic potions. The entire enemy army is made up of bizarre creatures recruited from Dr. Frank himself! And there is no shortage of danger everywhere on the island. Don't you understand anything? No one on the island is either! All we know is that a great reward awaits whoever reconstructs the pieces of Body Island. And who can resist rewards?

game.name: Elemental Master
game.desc: In Elemental Master, you control a mystical warrior called Laden through vertically scrolling scenarios, where enemies move down the screen with the intention of preventing the hero from reaching the location of the game's villain, his brother Roki. Elemental Master is basically a shoot 'em up with power-ups and everything, with the difference that instead of a ship, we have a warrior running towards his destination.

game.name: Empire of Steel
game.desc: The game presents itself as an old-time war film produced by "HOT-B Film Corporation". In the film the skies are populated by zeppelins, large warships and flying fortresses. In this age of steel, the Motorhead Empire has conquered and enslaved almost the entire planet. The last free nation, the Silverhead Republic, attempts to overthrow the Motorhead Empire using their newly developed weapon, the lightning bomb. Aside from its unusual Steampunk setting, Steel Empire is a fairly traditional side-scrolling shoot-'em-up. At the beginning of each phase, the player chooses between an attack plane and a zeppelin. While the plane is faster, the zeppelin has a longer life bar and can therefore take more damage. Both ships use the same standard weapon, which can be fired forward or backward, as well as bombs that are automatically released when fired. Also available are a limited number of lightning bombs that damage or destroy all enemies on the screen. Defeated enemies often lose power-ups, including health-replenishing hearts, lightning bombs, bonus points, extra lives, options, and experience points. Options are small "drones" that fly alongside the player's ship and imitate its behavior. Experience points can be collected to level up the ships' weapons (up to level 20) and thus increase their firepower.

game.name: Ghostbusters
game.desc: If you thought the Ghostbusters were done with their work after their latest victory, you were dead wrong. The ghosts returned to the city, Peter, Raymond and Egon returned to their posts ready to save the world. But then again, hunting ghosts requires a lot of money, equipment and, of course, a lot of courage. Are you daring enough to lead the Ghostbusters to the end of their mission? Are you determined enough to solve the terrible mystery of the missing tombstone? Once inside the demon world, there is no turning back! Ghosts, hauntings, elves; call it whatever you want. They are awaiting your arrival. Therefore, before facing them, don't forget to equip yourself with powerful weapons. It's the only way to stop them!

game.name: Golden Axe
game.desc: The game takes place in the fictional land named Yuria. a medieval fantasy world in the style of Conan the Barbarian. An evil entity known as Death Adder captured the king and his daughter, keeping them both captive inside his castle. Death Adder also finds the Golden Axe, which is Yuria's symbol, and with it, he threatens to destroy both the ax and the royal family unless Yuria's people accept him as their ruler. So, three warriors set out on a mission to save Yuria and avenge their losses at the hands of Death Adder. The first is Gilius Thunderhead, from the Wolud mines, who had his twin brother murdered by Death Adder's soldiers. The second is the barbarian Ax Battler, who seeks revenge for the murder of his mother. And last but not least, we have Tyris Flare, who had her parents murdered by Death Adder himself. The warriors rescued the inhabitants of the then-plundered Turtle Village, named after the shell of a giant turtle. This turtle takes the heroes across the sea and then flies to Death Adder's castle on the back of a giant eagle. Once at the castle, the heroes defeat Death Adder, who was taking over the Golden Ax, and save Yuria.

game.name: Golden Axe II
game.desc: The diabolical Dark Guld recovered from his last defeat and returned even more determined to make Earth the stage of his destruction. He came accompanied by a clan of wicked creatures and stole the Golden Axe, a golden ax symbol of peace and prosperity. Once again, our brave warriors will put themselves in the path of evildoers. They are: Ax-Battler, the barbarian; Tyris-Flare, the fierce Amazon; and Gilius Thunderhead, the fearless dwarf. No matter how difficult the battle, no matter how long the journey, nothing will stop them. The Golden Ax must return to its rightful place. And these terrible enemies of humanity too! Help them in this arduous mission!

game.name: Golden Axe III
game.desc: The legendary ax of power, the Golden Axe, has been stolen (again) and the land of Yuria has been placed in danger (again). This time the one who stole the golden ax was the ?Prince of Darkness? who, in addition, placed a curse on all warriors and heroes. Some of these heroes, however, manage to escape this curse and now have the mission to save the other warriors, defeat the villain and return with the Golden Axe. Among the new heroes we have the giant Proud Cragger, who escaped from an enemy prison and still appears wearing chains on his arms and legs. He's slow, but he's the strongest of them all. We also have the interesting werepanther Chronos ?Evil? Lait, who is quite agile, but in terms of strength is the weakest of the group; the barbarian Kain Grinder, who is similar to Ax Battler and the Amazon Sarah Barn, who resembles Tyris Flare.

game.name: Gunstar Heroes
game.desc: The story began a long, long time ago... The famous Professor White Gunstar became the greatest hero on Planet Gunstar 9. At that time, a powerful robot known as Golden Silver was devastating the planet. But the Professor managed to remove the four Mystic Stones from him, and expel him to a distant moon. Many years passed and everything was calm. But a dictator named Colonel Red, figuring the Gunstar family would know where the stones are, has kidnapped the eldest son, Green, and is forcing him to be obedient! That's where you enter the story. As the Professor's son, you must stop the Colonel and stop him from bringing back the terror of Golden Siver. It won't be easy at all, the fight will be against androids and powerful weapons. Call your friends and fight for real! Gunstar 9 is counting on you!
game.genre: Tiro / Run And Gun, Plataforma / Tiro Com Rolagem, Tiro, Plataforma

game.name: Haunting Starring Polterguy
game.desc: The ghost of a teenager seeks revenge on a snobbish family. Your job is to scare them into leaving their homes. They can't see you, so your only means of scaring them away is by possessing various objects throughout the house. For example, owning a piece of furniture would cause something to come out of it and possess an object that would make it come alive in one way or another. You need to act quickly, because you have something called "ecto", which acts as the fuel that allows you to move through the real world. The more scares you get, the more ecto you earn. Losing all ecto sends you to the underworld, where you have to regain your ecto to full capacity to return to the real world.

game.name: Jewel Master
game.desc: As the peaceful kingdom of Mythgard approaches being overthrown by the demon king Jardine the Mad, the kingdom's Elemental Masters have joined together in battle. They fought Jardine until there were no more than four of them left. The remaining four combined their powers to form the Elemental Blade that can be used to defeat the demon king. The Jewel Master was summoned to wield the blade, but it was lost and the rings of the elemental masters were scattered across Mythgard, except for two. The Jewel Master must seek out the other ten rings from the Elemental Masters and retrieve the blade for the final confrontation with the demon king. The gameplay is platform-based with fighting against various monsters like in any arcade classic. To do this, you have several rings at your disposal, two of which you start with in the game and the others are obtained along the way. Each ring is from one of the four elements, and by combining them new effects are created. Rings of opposing elements cancel each other out, however you have two hands so you can have fire effects in one of them and water in the other (for example). The rings also have different levels of strength, increasing the complexity of the combinations.

game.name: Kid Chameleon
game.desc: Kid Chameleon is a side-scroller platform game where the main character enters a virtual reality called "Wild Side" to free other children who have been captured. He can change his shape into several others (hence the "Chameleon" - Chameleon in English). This gives you special abilities that must be used to pass each of the game's 100+ stages. An interesting fact about Kid Chameleon is that the game has more than 100 levels (several of them very, very difficult) and that they must be played in sequence and there is no possibility of saving or using a password - which means that completing this game is an extraordinary feat of perseverance (and patience).

game.name: Mortal Kombat
game.desc: Simply Deadly! The seven best fighters are gathered to defeat the great champion Goro and the terrible demon Shang Tsung. Different fighting styles and chilling special moves! A great arcade success, now on Mega Drive, with 16 Mega digitized graphics and lots of speed in movement. Remember: the mind is much more powerful than the body. In combat between two equal fighters, what decides is wisdom. Choose the best strategy, focus and good luck! What is at stake is not victory. It's your life! Destroy enemies with Johnny Cage's shadow kick! Liu Kang's fireball will extinguish opponents! Face the best warriors in the tournament! Goro still resists! Destroy it! Come here! You are under Scorpion's control! Lots of energy and concentration. Who is the best?

game.name: MUSHA : Metallic Uniframe Super Hybrid Armor
game.desc: M.U.S.H.A is a shoot'em up for Megadrive. You are in the cockpit of a "Metallic Uniframe Super Hybrid Armor" or "Suoer Armor Híbrida Uniframe Metálica" and your objective is to destroy as many enemies as possible throughout the game's levels. Various bonuses can be picked up along the way, including small satellites that can defend or attack for you.

game.name: Probotector
game.desc: A criminal military faction stole an alien cell remaining from the Alien War that took place in the last game in the franchise, Contra III, and plans to use it to resurrect and clone an alien called Red Falcon, the most dangerous being that has ever existed. Thus, the player is then introduced to the Hard Corps, a military terrestrial defense organization that has four soldiers highly trained in special alien containment techniques and operations and, as one of them, must go through several very difficult stages in order to prevent criminals from being able to carry out their plans, something that could put the entire planet in danger.

game.name: Pulseman
game.desc: Pulseman is an electric hero who was created to combat cybercrime. Fight the "galaxy" gang across 7 stages with around 50 levels. Pulseman is best described as a fusion of Sonic the Hedgehog and Mega Man gameplay.

game.name: Ristar
game.desc: Catch a star! Ristar, the captured son of a legendary hero, is the solar system's last hope against the evil space pirate: Greedy. Ristar must travel to seven planets to try and restore peace and, of course, last but not least, free his father. Ristar stretches out his long, elastic arms to grab enemies and destroy them without mercy. Discover totally different worlds with new creatures on each planet. Attack strange beings that are not exactly what they seem to be! Have fun with a game that combines action and strategy with a character that surprises you at every moment.

game.name: Road Rash
game.desc: No speed limit! Ride an incredible racing motorcycle along the roads of California. Dodge cows, oil puddles and cars coming towards you! No rules! Disguise yourself from 15 other motorcyclists who are in your way. No! You don't understand! It's not overtaking them... it's kicking them, knocking them down! Everything goes here!! There will be 5 races in each level and at the end of each one you will win a certain amount of money. For what? To buy even faster motorcycles! Let's go! Enter the most illegal, dangerous and exciting race of your life!

game.name: Road Rash II
game.desc: A motorcycle racing game with attitude. You race in varied environments to earn more and more money. With this money you can buy faster and better motorcycles. There are many objects on the way to observe, from cars to rocks and signs, if you hit one you will fly and lose valuable time. If you crash too often, your bike could be destroyed. You can also attack other riders. The default attack is a punch, but some pilots have weapons, which you can steal and use against them. Police patrol several races, so if you're not careful, you could be arrested. Road Rash II is not just a racing game but also a fighting game.

game.name: Rocket Knight Adventures
game.desc: Rocket Knight Adventures is a platform/action game for the Mega Drive. The protagonist is called Sparkster, a fearless possum who wields his sword and wears his armor with rockets (hence the name Rocket Knight) to save the princess from the traitor Axel Gear, a former ally who ended up betraying everyone with his excessive ambition. The player needs to overcome seven stages with action and several enemies along the way. You will have your sword to attack and you can launch a projectile at a short distance. It is possible to charge the rocket bar to launch a frontal attack or, if the player does not press the directional pad, he can launch a spinning attack without moving. The character can collect several items along the way and one in particular called "Power Item" keeps the rocket bar at maximum for a short period of time, but enough to cause considerable damage to enemies.

game.path: ./Shinobi III - Return of the Ninja Master (BR).7z
game.name: Shinobi III : Return of the Ninja Master
game.desc: Do you know Joe Musashi? A tip: he ended the plans of the criminal organization Neo Zeed, using his incredible knowledge of martial arts. Exactly, Joe is actually Master Shinobi! After defeating this evil gang, Shinobi decided to return to Japan and further perfect his ninja techniques. But meanwhile, Neo City saw the return of crime and the terrible organization Neo Zeed! Now in his best form, Shinobi will have to face the most dangerous bandits and weapons using his magic, his sword, shurikens and a lot of strength to free the city. With your horse or even a jet ski, face 25 levels of fury! Courage, ninja warrior!

game.name: Socket
game.desc: The hero Socket (or Minute, in the Japanese version) is a time traveler and needs to stop the dangerous Time Dominator. The game takes a lot of inspiration from Sonic, including his speed, and places the traveling duck as a great conductor of electrical energy, which would explain his agility. The gameplay has an emphasis on platform style. You will need to escape mazes and explore the levels in search of items.

game.name: Sonic & Knuckles
game.desc: Sonic & Knuckles continues the story directly where Sonic the Hedgehog 3 left off. The Death Egg's explosion sends Sonic deep into Angel Island in Mushroom Hill. Sonic discovers that the Master Emerald is hidden somewhere on the island and is sure that Dr. Robotnik wants it to give his Death Egg unlimited power. Knuckles probably knows where it is - but can Sonic stop Robotnik's plans and find the Master Emerald while fighting Knuckles? Meanwhile, Knuckles is watching the island when he is attacked by one of Robotnik's robots! He quickly begins a chase for revenge.

game.name: Sonic & Knuckles
game.desc: Sonic & Knuckles continues the story directly where Sonic the Hedgehog 3 left off. The Death Egg's explosion sends Sonic deep into Angel Island in Mushroom Hill. Sonic discovers that the Master Emerald is hidden somewhere on the island and is sure that Dr. Robotnik wants it to give his Death Egg unlimited power. Knuckles probably knows where it is - but can Sonic stop Robotnik's plans and find the Master Emerald while fighting Knuckles? Meanwhile, Knuckles is watching the island when he is attacked by one of Robotnik's robots! He quickly begins a chase for revenge.

game.name: Sonic & Knuckles + Sonic The Hedgehog 2
game.desc: Knuckles the Echidna in Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (or simply Knuckles in Sonic 2) is a platform game resulting from the combination of Sonic & Knuckles and Sonic the Hedgehog 2 using the cartridge's exclusive "lock-on" technology. As the name suggests, this game is essentially identical to Sonic the Hedgehog 2 with the exception of Knuckles the Echidna starring as the main character and Sonic the Hedgehog and Miles "Tails" Prower are not playable in the game.

game.name: Sonic & Knuckles + Sonic The Hedgehog 3
game.desc: Dr. Eggman's (aka Dr. Robotnik) Death Egg was once again destroyed by Sonic, crashing into the top of a volcano on Floating Island. Dr. Eggman is still free, and Sonic can't let him get his hands on the Master Emerald in order to repair the Death Egg. Sonic should also stay away from Knuckles, who is also in trouble. As the guardian of the Floating Island and all the emeralds, Knuckles has the responsibility of keeping the island safe. While Sonic and Knuckles are busy fighting, who will stop Dr. Eggman?
game.genre: Plataforma, Plataforma / Corre E Pula Com Rolagem

game.name: Sonic 3
game.desc: Dr. Robotnik's Death Egg has landed on Angel Island, also known as the Floating Island because it harnesses the power of the Master Emerald to float in the air. Robotnik needs her to repair the Death Egg, so he tells the island's guardian, Knuckles the Echidna that Sonic and Tails are there to steal it. With Knuckles tricked and trying to stop the heroes, will they be able to stop Robotnik in time?

game.name: Sonic 3D Flickies' Island
game.desc: While visiting Flicky Island, Sonic notices that the Flickies, his little feathered friends who can travel between parallel worlds, have been captured and turned into badniks (Sonic's robot enemies) by Dr. Robotnik in his never-ending search for the Chaos Emeralds. Seven stages separate Sonic from the final confrontation with Robotnik. Sonic 3D Blast was the last Sonic title released for the Mega Drive, the blue blur's only platform game on the Sega Saturn and one of its rare appearances on PCs. The title, considering the time in which it was released, is somewhat misleading, as instead of 3D graphics, it uses an isometric view where Sonic can move not only forward and backward, but also left and right. Gameplay is much slower compared to other games in the series and the number of badniks has been reduced to five in each section. As usual, when Sonic destroys a badnik, an animal jumps free from inside, but this time Sonic has to catch it and take them to an interdimensional ring. While they can be picked up one by one, exploring the level with all five allows the player to reach otherwise inaccessible items. Unlike all other previous games, time is not a requirement: if the player completes a level in more than 10 minutes, it means there will be no time bonus at the end. Finally, to collect all seven Chaos Emeralds, Sonic must first find Tails or Knuckles and offer them at least 50 rings.

game.name: Sonic The Hedgehog
game.desc: Sonic the Hedgehog is the first of many games starring SEGA's flagship rodent, Sonic. It's a side scrolling platformer with one difference: speed. Sonic runs through levels with incredible speed, allowing him to traverse loops and jumps with ease. The game's plot is simple. The evil Dr. Robotnik has captured many of Sonic's animal friends on South Island, and trapped them inside robots. Fortunately, Sonic can free his friends by destroying the robots with his Spin Attack. Meanwhile, Dr. Robotnik is trying to control the all-powerful Chaos Emeralds. Sonic must catch them before he does in the special rotating stages.

game.name: Sonic The Hedgehog 2
game.desc: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 is a speed-based side-scrolling platformer and the sequel to Sonic the Hedgehog. Like the original, players race through different worlds called "zones" which each have their own specific theme. There are two Acts in almost all 10 Zones, and at the end of the last Act of each Zone is a machine that Robotnik controls that you must defeat to progress. The evil Dr. Robotnik wants to conquer the world. To do this, he imprisons and transforms all animals into robots called "Badniks". This way they can build their powerful weapon, the Death Egg. Only Sonic the Hedgehog, and his new partner, Miles 'Tails' Prower, can stop Robotnik and his army of Badniks from conquering the world. Sonic and Tails can collect rings that are scattered throughout the levels. As with most platformers, when the player collects 100 rings, they gain an extra life. However, the rings also act as protection; If Sonic is hit when he is carrying rings, they scatter everywhere and he is briefly invincible. If he gets hit again when he has no rings, he will lose a life. If the player reaches a checkpoint post with 50 or more rings, they will be able to access the Special Stage. In this stage, you must collect a set amount of rings in a skate park-style stage before reaching a checkpoint. Complete all checkpoints and you will earn one of seven Chaos Emeralds. New to Sonic the Hedgehog 2 is the ability to play the game co-op with a friend - at any time, a player can connect a second controller and take control of Tails. Tails has infinite lives and the camera remains focused on Sonic, meaning Tails will not impede the game. Sonic (and Tails) can now also gain speed by repeatedly pressing the jump button for a "Spin Dash". This is useful when stuck near steep slopes or other areas where you need some momentum. The game also has a 2-player versus mode. This mode is a horizontally split-screen race through stages based on three of the main game's zones.

game.name: Streets of Rage
game.desc: This city was once a happy and peaceful place... Until one day, a powerful criminal organization took over the city. A cruel union soon had control of the government and even the police. The city has become a center of violence and crime, where no one is safe. Amid this turmoil, a group of determined young people vowed to clean up the city. Among them are Adam Hunter, Axel Stone and Blaze Fielding. They are willing to risk anything... even their lives... on... Streets Of Rage.

game.name: Streets of Rage 3
game.desc: The Crime Syndicate strikes back! Mr-X, the most terrible of villains is back with a diabolical plan: exchange all the city's leaders for robots. And dominate them with a simple remote control! This way, he will have the entire city in his hands, and will be able to take revenge on those responsible for his last failure... But things won't be that easy for the Union. Blaze, Axel, Skate and a new team member, Dr. Zan, are more than willing to get things in order. To do this, they just need a leader with courage. Will you face it? New moves, and secret moves! Two-player and co-op attacks and Head-to-Head battles! Four different endings. Whoever plays better will see! Amazing sound effects and music! Many new stages and scenarios!

game.name: Streets of Rage II
game.desc: Streets of Rage 2 is the continuation of Streets of Rage, and its plot basically tells that in the past young ex-police officers Axel Stone, Adam Hunter and Blaze Fielding celebrated the victory against the criminal syndicate, a year after its fall. Axel became a bodyguard and Blaze now works as a dance teacher, but Adam decides to join the police again and starts living in a small house with his younger brother. One day Axel receives a desperate call from Eddie "Skate" Hunter (also known as Eddie "Sammy" Hunter) saying that when he arrived at the small house, it was completely torn apart and destroyed. Adam's disappearance marks the beginning of the nightmare, within days the syndicate was back on the streets, now completely renewed and with many new criminal fighters, from armed ninjas to even bomb-throwing motorcyclists. Axel contacts Max, his old friend; Blaze and Sammy (Skate), and decide to team up to once again destroy the syndicate's criminal organization, rescue Adam and reestablish order and peace.

game.name: Strider
game.desc: Can your nerves handle 8 Mega of excitement? Yes, because you need nerves of steel and a lot of courage in this hallucinating adventure. You are Strider, a mountain of muscles with an efficient punch and a laser sword. You are in a future land with a past environment and the Master of Evil is mocking your defeat. Protect your wrists with iron bracelets and enter the fortress. You will have to survive the attack of robots with wings, scary prehistoric animals and an entire army. Fight against seductive Amazons who throw violent boomerangs and enter a war destined to dominate even your mind. Slide, duck, escape bombs, face monkeys and giant metal centipedes! Feel your biceps burst as you strive to defeat muscular men, who also make grunts. Strider, the Master of Evil, awaits you. You know you can defeat him!

game.path: ./Super Street Fighter II - The New Challengers (BR).bin.7z
game.name: Super Street Fighter II
game.desc: For years the twelve greatest fighters in the world have faced each other. And they became the great masters. But it's time for a new challenge. Four fighters emerged with a lot of promise, skills and one certainty: they can destroy Bison! But are they capable of facing the famous Street Fighters and their new moves? 4 new characters: Cammy, Dee Jay, T. Hawk and Fei Long. Even better hits for the fantastic original Street Fighters. More battle mode options: Group Battle, Tournament Battle and the challenge against the clock in Time Challenge. Scenarios with incredible graphics!

game.name: The Adventures of Batman & Robin
game.desc: In this adventure, based on the award-winning TV series, Bat-Man got himself into trouble. His archenemy, Mr. Freeze, intends to turn Gotham into a great glacier. And to make matters worse, he teamed up with the Joker, Two-Face and other evildoers to eliminate our heroes once and for all.

game.name: The Revenge of Shinobi
game.desc: You are Musashi, the ninja master. As one of the mystical warriors, you have the power to see and know everything, and now you have to destroy Neo Zeed's evil army. If you fail, Naoko, the beautiful hostage, will die. Attack with the Ninja sword and daggers. Somersault over fences while throwing deadly knives. Dodge bombs, deadly stars and junk cars by jumping, turning and kicking! The Neo Zeed are almost unbeatable, and will be after you in 24 treacherous scenes. But you have a secret weapon: ninja magic.

game.name: Thunder Force II
game.desc: 18 years ago, the planet Nebula was attacked by the Lone Star System, arch enemy of the Interplanetary Federation. The population has been decimated and the few survivors have sworn to protect the future of the planet, whatever the cost! The time has come to show that they were serious! Plealos, the mothership of the System fleet, is on alert at the Nebula spaceport, ready to destroy everything it cannot stop. You are Ryder Jupiter, known as the Ace of the Federation. The only person you trust is Diana Rean, and you unite against the tyrant Reficul, Emperor of the Lone Star. Only Thunder Force II can put an end to Nebula's plans for domination. Pilot the super jet across the planet's surface to the Plealos Fortress for the final confrontation, where you can use a bomb so terrible that it leaves nothing behind but memories... Go ahead, brave warrior, and free the Federation from the hands of the evil Reficul.

game.name: Thunder Force III
game.desc: Anyone who thinks they've seen everything in space combat won't miss out by waiting. In Thunder Force III you pilot the most advanced ships! You will cross several planets in the galaxy: fire, water, earth and many others. When you arrive at each of them you will receive information about the biggest enemy you will defeat and also their weak point. But until you reach the final fight, you will face a variety of dangers and surprises. Your objective: eliminate all enemies on the different planets to face the mothership that controls the galaxy. This is what you are so well equipped for. That's why he spent so much time in training. A mission like this isn't given to just anyone. You know this and you will deserve this choice.

game.name: Thunder Force IV
game.desc: The super computer that we thought was destroyed was only damaged. The federation has decided to send you on a ship to destroy this threat. Thunder Force IV, known in North America as Lightening Force: Quest for the Darkstar, is a 1992 game developed and published by Technosoft for the Sega Genesis as the fourth installment in the Thunder Force series. The game was released in Japan on July 24, 1992, in North America in September 1992, and in Europe in December 1992.

game.name: Tiny Toon Adventures : Buster's Hidden Treasure
game.desc: In addition to the funniest cartoons on television, the ACME City gang decided to get involved in video games. It all started when Buster decided to clean up the basement of Looniversidade ACME, and suddenly found a treasure map. But the terrible Valentino struck again! He stole the map, and on top of that he got a special helmet to force the gang to look for the treasure. Do you think that's all? No, Valentino this time went even further. He kidnapped Lilica and her friends, to keep our friend busy. Yeah, this time Buster is in trouble. But really fun troubles! There will be 33 exciting levels, and the island where the treasure is located has different dangers every inch! Good thing Buster can count on Godo Dodo... and you! Or will you leave your friend alone in this ACME problem?

game.name: Tom Mason's Dinosaurs for Hire
game.desc: The dinosaurs are back! And these terrible prehistoric monsters are ready to attack with their huge sharp fangs... Lie! This story of fangs, attacks and bites is a thing of the past! Modern Dinosaur is different: use the most fantastic weapons to defeat prehistoric beasts and ninjas created by a crazy dictator. These friendly dinos don't care about gigantic monsters or dangerous situations. They want gunpowder! This will be your new gang: Archie, the Tyrannosaurus Rex, is the leader of the dinosaurs and has only one idea in his head: to eliminate. Lorenzo is a surfing Triceratops, who will make a lot of noise with his 50 caliber gun. Last but not least destructive, Reese, the Stegosaurus, willing to blast enemies with his cannon.

game.name: Vectorman 2
game.desc: This is the sequel to Vectorman. Now the powerful little robot has been attacked while returning to earth in his spaceship. When you fall to the ground, you end up discovering obscure locations full of hostile creatures and ending up participating in a fast and furious platform action. Fight your enemies, collect photons, jump over obstacles, find weapons, transform into other creatures and climb walls commanding the green "orbot" Vectorman robot.

game.name: World of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse and Donald
game.desc: CHAZAM!! Magically, the most famous characters in the Disney world, Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck, were transported to a mysterious world, where dreams are reality and the unexpected always happens! How do I find my way back? Only through magic... transforming enemies with a bewitched cloak, magic powder or a magic wand!! To explore the World of Illusion they can hitch a ride on a flying carpet or be submerged in the depths of the ocean through air bubbles!! And since friendship comes first here, only by working as a team will Mickey and Donald be able to return home. By the way, speaking of friends, do you know who is also here? Minnie, Margarida, Pluto, Clarabela, Huguinho, Zezinho and Luisinho... the only thing left is you to complete this special group!!
